field.tier.note: the engagement tier: Active, Cooling, At risk, Sunset

field.source.note: how the contact was added: a form, an import, the API

field.custom.note: key: the custom field's key, like plan

op.in_last.note: followed by a number of days or weeks: in the last 30 days

op.not_in_last.note: followed by a number of days or weeks

op.since.note: Signed in to the website since a date

option.paid_tier.andAbove.note: tier: a paid tier's name, like Insider

option.store_bought.collection.note: store: a connected store's name; collection: one of its product collections

option.store_bought.product.note: store: a connected store's name; product: one of its products

option.referral_milestone.milestone.note: list: the referral program's list; reward: the milestone's reward, like Sticker pack

source.import.note: importer: Brevo, Mailchimp, CSV, XLSX… (a name)

source.importerFile.note: an import from a file of an unknown kind, in source.import: File import

source.formNamed.note: form: the form's slug, like blog

problem.timeout: The count took longer than 10 s. Segments with event conditions over many contacts can be slow on default Postgres settings; the segment still works at send time.
problem.sqlDisabled: SQL segments are turned off on this database. An admin can enable them by running: CREATE ROLE reputecast_segments NOLOGIN; GRANT reputecast_segments TO '<app user>'; then reputecast migrate up
problem.name: Give the segment a name.
problem.tooManyGroups: A segment can have at most 20 groups.
problem.match: Pick ALL or ANY for each group.

problem.emptyGroup.message: Group {n} has no conditions. Add one or remove the group.
problem.emptyGroup.note: n: the group's number, 1 for the first

problem.tooManyConditions: A group can have at most 50 conditions.

problem.unknownField.message: {field} is not a field you can filter on.
problem.unknownField.note: field: what was sent, in quotes

problem.unknownOp.note: field: a field's name (Mailbox provider); op: what was sent, in quotes

problem.periodRange.message: {field} needs a number of days or weeks between 1 and 3650.
problem.periodRange.note: field: a field's name, like Last open

problem.periodUnit.note: field: a field's name, like Last open

problem.pickList.note: field: a field's name in lower case, like list membership

problem.listGone: That list doesn't exist in this workspace any more.

problem.pickLanguage.note: field: a field's name in lower case, like language

problem.pickValue.note: field: a field's name in lower case, like mailbox provider

problem.number.note: field: a field's name, like Custom field · mrr

problem.date.note: field: a field's name; the date shows the format to type, keep it as is

problem.enterValue.note: field: a field's name in lower case, like email domain

problem.bothEnds: Enter both ends of the range.
problem.rangeSwapNumbers: The range ends below where it starts. Swap the two numbers.
problem.rangeSwapAmounts: The range ends below where it starts. Swap the two amounts.
problem.ltv: The lifetime value needs an amount, like 50.
problem.score: The score needs a number from 0 to 100.
problem.scoreBothEnds: Enter both ends of the range, from 0 to 100.
problem.orders: The number of orders needs a whole number.
problem.spent: The total spent needs an amount, like 100 or 250.50.
problem.lastOrderRange: Last store order needs a number of days or weeks between 1 and 3650.
problem.lastOrderUnit: Last store order needs days or weeks.
problem.pickProductOrCollection: Pick a product or a collection.
problem.pickProduct: Pick a product, or any product.
problem.signedInDate: Pick a date like 2026-09-29, or a number of days ago.
problem.referrals: Enter a number of referrals, 0 or more.
problem.pickReferralOrPartner: Pick a referral or a partner.
sql.empty: Write a SELECT that returns contact ids, for example: SELECT c.id FROM contacts c WHERE c.tier = 'active'

sql.tooLong.message: SQL segments are limited to {max} characters.

sql.oneStatement: Only one statement is allowed: remove the semicolon and anything after it.
sql.selectOnly: A SQL segment must be a SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) that returns contact ids.
sql.string: A quoted string is never closed.
sql.identifier: A quoted identifier is never closed.
sql.dollar: A dollar-quoted string is never closed.

sql.views.message: Your SQL can only read the {views} views ({detail}).
sql.views.note: views: the view names, a list like contacts, lists and memberships; detail: Postgres's own error, in English

sql.idColumnUUID: The query must return the contact id (a uuid) in a column named id, for example SELECT c.id FROM contacts c.
sql.idColumn: The query must return the contact id in a column named id, for example SELECT c.id FROM contacts c.
sql.readOnly: SQL segments are read-only: they can't change data.
sql.roles: SQL segments can't change roles or session settings.
